advancedArguments.name: fromDate
advancedArguments.description: Start of the date range to fetch grievance history for, formatted "DD/Mon/YYYY" with a 3-letter month name, e.g. "11/Jun/2026" - this screen does NOT use the usual D/M/YYYY format used elsewhere. Optional - omit to default to 3 months before today.

raw.description: Start of the date range to fetch grievance history for, formatted "DD/Mon/YYYY" with a 3-letter month name, e.g. "11/Jun/2026" - this screen does NOT use the usual D/M/YYYY format used elsewhere. Optional - omit to default to 3 months before today.

advancedArguments.name: toDate
advancedArguments.description: End of the date range, same "DD/Mon/YYYY" format, e.g. "11/Sep/2026". Optional - omit to default to today.

raw.description: End of the date range, same "DD/Mon/YYYY" format, e.g. "11/Sep/2026". Optional - omit to default to today.

advancedArguments.name: ground
advancedArguments.description: The grievance ground/category to filter by, exactly as the user names it (e.g. "Workload"). Do not ask the user for a code - the tool resolves the name against Beacon's live grounds list itself. Omit to include all grounds.

raw.description: The grievance ground/category to filter by, exactly as the user names it (e.g. "Workload"). Do not ask the user for a code - the tool resolves the name against Beacon's live grounds list itself. Omit to include all grounds.

advancedArguments.name: status
advancedArguments.description: Filter by grievance status: "Pending" (not yet completed), "Resolved" (completed), or "Appealed" (an appeal was raised). Omit to include all statuses.

raw.description: Filter by grievance status: "Pending" (not yet completed), "Resolved" (completed), or "Appealed" (an appeal was raised). Omit to include all statuses.

advancedArguments.name: appealableOnly
advancedArguments.description: Set true when the user asks whether they can appeal, or wants only grievances eligible for appeal right now (e.g. "which grievances can I appeal", "can I submit an appeal"). Do not just list every grievance and guess from status text - not all completed/disagreed grievances are actually appeal-able (attempts remaining, appeal window, etc. are enforced server-side), so this checks Beacon's own eligibility flag per record. Omit for a normal history listing.

raw.description: Set true when the user asks whether they can appeal, or wants only grievances eligible for appeal right now (e.g. "which grievances can I appeal", "can I submit an appeal"). Do not just list every grievance and guess from status text - not all completed/disagreed grievances are actually appeal-able (attempts remaining, appeal window, etc. are enforced server-side), so this checks Beacon's own eligibility flag per record. Omit for a normal history listing.
